NO labels, options, hints or validation strings — obligation-purity boot guard enforces.

GET: state.get() ONCE; prefill from answers; compute DERIVED rollups from answers.commodityLines — netWeightTotal = sum of Number(line.netWeight), packagesTotal = sum of Number(line.numberOfPackages) — render-only, NEVER committed/stored. One render() helper for GET + POST errors; kit.base() view; back link hubPath(journey.journeyId). POST: read raw request.payload; validate with lib/validate factories, Joi-voice single-layer (c-018), one canonical string per rule: totalGrossWeight required 'Enter the total gross weight'; numeric 'Total gross weight must be a number'; must exceed the derived net rollup 'Total gross weight must be greater than the net weight'; max 5 decimal places expressed ON the field itself 'Total gross weight must have 5 decimal places or fewer'; grossVolume numeric when present 'Total gross volume must be a number'; PAIRING as controller fieldset rules (house D-13 email-OR-telephone precedent): unit posted without volume → error on grossVolume 'Enter the total gross volume'; volume posted without unit → error on grossVolumeUnit 'Select a unit type'. Unit membership rule built inside POST from services/reference/gross-volume-units.js codes (never a frozen module-level schema list). Invalid → 400 re-render RAW values; valid → state.commit() cleaned values wrapped in kit.recoverableSave() (marked failure → recoverableError:true, 500; other errors throw); redirect await kit.nextTarget(request, page, committed.scope). routes = kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post }).

Nested govuk-grid-row: govukInput grossVolume (label 'Total gross volume (optional)', inputmode 'numeric') in govuk-grid-column-two-thirds beside govukSelect grossVolumeUnit (label 'Unit', placeholder option 'Select unit' value '', options from gross-volume-units.js rendered by label, submitted by CODE) in govuk-grid-column-one-third. Shared error summary ('There is a problem' — c-004, NOT legacy 'Please fix the following errors') + shared save actions. Input name = id = error key for every control so #<fieldName> summary links focus. NO legacy chrome: no href='#' back link, no heading-tertiary reference span (house dynamic reference caption is the hub/layout's concern), no etag field (no optimistic concurrency in the house model), no CHED-P/D radios.

notes: 1:1 carry of inc-019; closes m3. Follows the add-a-section recipe (cheat-sheet §3) in its one-page degenerate form: one page = one feature folder = one flow section = one task row = one hub spoke (spoke 4, §2.1). Exemplars: live-animals import-reason feature (smallest complete collecting page — controller/render/copy shape), transport section (section + task row + hub GROUPS wiring), origin e2e spec (per-rule validation + axe pattern), _species-quantities.njk (inputmode numeric idiom). Decisions applied, all grounded in the page spec + plan: (1) legacy page-optional/submit-required split on gross weight RESOLVED as model-mandatory (planningBrief says mandatory; c-018 single-layer validation means there is no second layer to defer to); required message uses GDS 'Enter the total gross weight' rather than legacy backend 'Add the total gross weight'. (2) gross>net rule gets ONE canonical wording — the legacy frontend string 'Total gross weight must be greater than the net weight' (page-spec discrepancies note asked Reconcile to pick one; the backend variant 'is less than' is discarded). (3) The legacy gross-weight-decimal phantom-field a11y defect is fixed by expressing the 5-decimal-places rule on the visible field with an anchorable message (page-spec openQuestion recommendation). (4) Unit persisted by CODE from pp-016's gross-volume-units.js, not the legacy hardcoded display string 'metres cubed' (page-spec openQuestion 5 decision). (5) Legacy presentation-table/table-responsive replaced by govukSummaryList without actions (page-spec govukAlternative; stays inside the govuk toolbox). (6) Rollups (net weight, packages) are DERIVED from commodityLines answers at render and never stored/sent (obligation-field-map inc-019 'derived — never stored'). (7) Legacy three-way exit collapsed: house kit.nextTarget/hub semantics; NO GMS interstitial (goods-movement is its own spoke, pp-031); review-change return is owned by the pp-038 check-answers Change machinery; back link is the house hubPath link, not href='#'. (8) CHED-P/D/A-only controls omitted per planningBrief. (9) Volume/unit pairing: presentGate gives unit-required-iff-volume in the MODEL; the reverse direction (unit posted without volume) is a controller fieldset rule per the house D-13 precedent — both directions validated in POST so no user input is silently dropped. (10) Check-answers rows for these fields are NOT built here — the check-answers feature is pp-038 (m4), which reads back every captured area; recipe step 5 is deliberately deferred to it. (11) obligation-field-map's inc-019 row also lists commodityComplement[].intendedForFinalUsers; that leaf is owned by pp-027 (commodity-bulk-details, matching its planningBrief) — recorded here so the duplicate mention is not double-built. (12) No etag equivalent: the records port is whole-document last-write-wins (Open Q 3 ruling in §6.2); lost-update protection is out of scope. Copy amounts to ~20 keys in both locales; e2e is one co-located spec plus a hub-spec extension.
openQuestions: Gross volume + unit are completely unexercised in legacy (no trace fills them, zero QA-repo references — page-spec openQuestion). Built here per the spec, but a BA could rule them dead surface and drop two controls; cheap question worth asking before or after build, non-blocking.

Exact stored codes for the two volume units are pp-016's call (e.g. LITRES / METRES_CUBED vs litres / m3); this increment consumes whatever gross-volume-units.js exports — confirm the module landed with codes, not display strings, before wiring the select.

Legacy 'does copy-as-new carry gross weight over / does mutating commodities clear it' is unresolved in the corpus (page-spec openQuestion). House model has no such implicit clearing — an out-of-scope-only wipe applies to grossVolumeUnit alone — but the copy-flow behaviour question transfers to pp-045 (copy-as-new), not here.

The 5-decimal-places bound and 16-char maxlength are inherited legacy limits; the maxlength cap is dropped (silent truncation is the defect the page spec flags) in favour of the numeric + decimal rules — flag if product wants an explicit upper-magnitude bound instead.
